tool_args.rationale: The eight observations support numerical comparison of additive and state-dependent sink models, with either fixed memory or a coupled relaxing memory state. Leave-one-out error selects among these smooth transient candidates before fresh confirmation; confirmation performance remains to be measured.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; its three additional rows provide variation in the transient state and memory.

considered_alternatives.option: Haldane, Cobb-Douglas, and static barrier-modulated siphon laws
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These recalled static laws omit the observed dependence on transient state and memory; the fitted candidates instead include both.
It is not a discriminating probe for the observed transient mechanism.
